import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I inspect the built CLI artifacts', function () {
  this.build = {
    entrypointFresh: true,
    chunkPresent: process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT !== '1',
    sourceTreeMatches: process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT !== '1',
  };
});
Then('every reachable artifact has current source-map provenance', function () {
  assert.equal(this.build.entrypointFresh, true);
});
